9	# FZ-041a benchmark harness label rename decision
10	
11	This is a decision artifact only. It decides how benchmark labels that still
12	say `ddx-agent` map into the Fizeau rename.
13	
14	## Decision
15	
16	Active benchmark harness labels for this product become `fiz`.
17	
18	`ddx-agent` is not retained as the active matrix harness label. In the benchmark
19	matrix, rows compare CLI harnesses such as `pi`, `opencode`, and this product's
20	CLI. The current product CLI is `fiz`, so `fiz` is the stable product-facing
21	benchmark label.
22	
23	Do not add a supported `ddx-agent` compatibility alias for new benchmark runs.
24	This follows the Fizeau rename policy: no compatibility window, and old command
25	names are historical evidence rather than active supported names.
26	
27	## Product-facing labels
28	
29	The following active surfaces are product-facing and should use `fiz` in the
30	benchmark implementation and active benchmark docs:
31	
32	| Surface | Current old label | Target label | Reason |
33	|---|---|---|---|
34	| `fiz-bench matrix --harnesses` value for this product | `ddx-agent` | `fiz` | Users type this value and it selects the product row. |
35	| Matrix defaults and examples | `ddx-agent,pi,opencode` | `fiz,pi,opencode` | Defaults and examples define current operator behavior. |
36	| `matrix.json` / `report.json` `harness` values | `ddx-agent` | `fiz` | These artifacts are published and compared across runs. |
37	| `matrix.md` row and cell labels | `ddx-agent` | `fiz` | Report readers see these as benchmark result labels. |
38	| New result directory path segments derived from harness labels | `ddx-agent` | `fiz` | Paths are part of the active result contract and should match the row label. |
39	| TerminalBench / Harbor `AgentInfo.Name` for new runs | `ddx-agent` | `fiz` | Harbor reporters use this name as the leaderboard/executor label. |
40	| The product adapter's active Python module path used by new matrix invocations | `ddx_agent.py` / `ddx-agent` | `fiz.py` / `fiz` | SD-010 maps harness labels to adapter modules; the visible active adapter should match the canonical harness ID. |
41	| Installed in-container executable name for new benchmark cells | `/installed-agent/ddx-agent` | `/installed-agent/fiz` | The cell executes the product CLI binary, whose active name is `fiz`. |
42	| Active benchmark operator docs and procedure snippets | `ddx-agent` / `ddx-agent-bench` | `fiz` / `fiz-bench` | These instruct current use rather than recording past runs. |
43	
44	## Domain and implementation terms that remain
45	
46	The rename does not change generic benchmark or Harbor terminology:
47	
48	| Surface | Decision | Reason |
49	|---|---|---|
50	| `AgentInfo` Go type and JSON object name | Keep | TerminalBench / Harbor schema term for the executor recorded in a trajectory. |
51	| `BaseInstalledAgent` and Harbor "agent" vocabulary | Keep | Third-party benchmark domain terminology, not product branding. |
52	| `HARBOR_AGENT_ARTIFACT` | Keep | Harbor adapter artifact input name; it is not a Fizeau-owned public env var. |
53	| Go/Python field names such as `Harness`, `harness`, `adapter`, `agent` | Keep | Generic benchmark model fields. Only their product string values change. |
54	| Generic prose such as "agent harness" or "agent exits" | Keep when generic | Describes the benchmark domain, not this product's old name. |
55	
56	## Historical labels
57	
58	`ddx-agent` remains allowed only where it records old evidence:
59	
60	- Archived benchmark baselines, old matrix memos, and old command transcripts
61	  produced before the rename decision.
62	- `.ddx/` tracker records, execution evidence, and review logs.
63	- HELIX or research documents that explicitly describe pre-rename history.
64	- Cleanup inventories that cite old strings for audit purposes.
65	
66	Historical material should not be mechanically rewritten just to satisfy a
67	grep. If a document is an active operator procedure or an active normative
68	benchmark spec, it is not historical for this purpose and should use the target
69	labels above.
70	
71	## Evidence used
72	
73	- `docs/research/fizeau-rename-allowlist-2026-04-30.md` classifies `ddx-agent`
74	  as forbidden in active CLI commands, examples, release assets, and active
75	  benchmark operator instructions, while allowing historical evidence.
76	- `.ddx/notes/FZ-029-user-facing-runtime-audit.md` deferred the benchmark
77	  harness adapter label to the dedicated benchmark rename beads.
78	- `docs/helix/02-design/solution-designs/SD-010-harness-matrix-benchmark.md`
79	  defines the matrix `--harnesses` input and output artifacts; those labels are
80	  visible in active reports rather than purely private implementation details.
81	- `internal/benchmark/external/termbench/trajectory.go` records `AgentInfo.Name`
82	  as the label Harbor reporters use for benchmark output.
83	
84	## Acceptance traceback
85	
86	Bead `agent-b69923cf` requires a decision note stating label policy and which
87	labels are product-facing versus historical.
88	
89	- Label policy: active benchmark product labels become `fiz`; no new
90	  `ddx-agent` compatibility alias.
91	- Product-facing labels: enumerated in "Product-facing labels".
92	- Historical labels: enumerated in "Historical labels".

254	func runMatrixTuple(opts matrixTupleOptions) (matrixRunReport, bool, error) {
255		cellDir := matrixTupleDir(opts.outDir, opts.harness, opts.profile.ID, opts.rep, opts.task.ID)
256		reportPath := filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixReportName)
257		if !opts.forceRerun {
258			if existing, ok, err := loadExistingMatrixReport(reportPath); err != nil {
259				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
260			} else if ok && shouldSkipMatrixReport(existing.FinalStatus, opts.resume, opts.retryBudgetHalted) {
261				return existing, true, nil
262			}
263		}
264	
265		release, err := acquireMatrixLock(filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixLockName))
266		if err != nil {
267			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
268		}
269		defer release()
270	
271		started := time.Now().UTC()
272		report := matrixRunReport{
273			Harness:         opts.harness,
274			ProfileID:       opts.profile.ID,
275			ProfilePath:     opts.profile.Path,
276			ProfileSnapshot: opts.profile.Versioning.Snapshot,
277			AdapterModule:   matrixAdapterModule(opts.harness),
278			HarborAgent:     filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("scripts", "benchmark", "harness_adapters", moduleFileName(opts.harness))) + ":Agent",
279			Rep:             opts.rep,
280			TaskID:          opts.task.ID,
281			Category:        opts.task.Category,
282			Difficulty:      opts.task.Difficulty,
283			OutputDir:       cellDir,
284			StartedAt:       started,
285			PricingSource:   profilePricingSource(opts.profile),
286		}
287	
288		if opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost >= opts.budgetUSD {
289			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
290			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
291			report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, false)
292			report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
293			if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
294				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
295			}
296			return report, false, nil
297		}
298	
299		workDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, "work")
300		if err := os.MkdirAll(workDir, 0o750); err != nil {
301			return matrixRunReport{}, false, fmt.Errorf("create tuple workdir: %w", err)
302		}
303		result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
304		if err != nil {
305			report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
306			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
307			report.Error = err.Error()
308		} else {
309			report.Command = result.Command.Argv
310			report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
311			report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
312			report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
313			if result.ExitCode != 0 {
314				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
315				report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
316			}
317			applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
318			if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
319				seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
320				report.WallSeconds = &seconds
321			}
322		}
323		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
324			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
325		}
326		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
327			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
328		}
329		if report.Reward != nil && report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
330			report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
331		}
332		report.CostUSD = matrixCostUSD(opts.profile, report)
333		if (opts.perRunBudgetUSD > 0 && report.CostUSD > opts.perRunBudgetUSD) ||
334			(opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost+report.CostUSD > opts.budgetUSD) {
335			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
336			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
337			report.Reward = nil
338		}
339		report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, report.Retriable)
340		report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
341		if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
342			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
343		}
344		return report, false, nil
345	}

516	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
517		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
518			return nil, err
519		}
520		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
521		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
522		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
523			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
524			if err == nil {
525				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
526					_ = f.Close()
527					_ = os.Remove(path)
528					return nil, werr
529				}
530				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
531					_ = os.Remove(path)
532					return nil, err
533				}
534				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
535			}
536			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
537				return nil, err
538			}
539			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
540			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
541				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
542					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
543				}
544				continue
545			}
546			pid := "unknown"
547			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
548				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
549			}
550			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
551		}
552		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)
553	}

662	func summarizeMatrixCells(runs []matrixRunReport) []matrixCell {
663		type acc struct {
664			cell          matrixCell
665			rewards       []float64
666			cost          float64
667			inputTokens   int
668			outputTokens  int
669			cachedTokens  int
670			retriedTokens int
671		}
672		byKey := map[string]*acc{}
673		for _, run := range runs {
674			key := run.Harness + "\x00" + run.ProfileID
675			a := byKey[key]
676			if a == nil {
677				a = &acc{cell: matrixCell{Harness: run.Harness, ProfileID: run.ProfileID}}
678				byKey[key] = a
679			}
680			a.cell.NRuns++
681			if run.Reward != nil {
682				a.cell.NReported++
683				a.rewards = append(a.rewards, float64(*run.Reward))
684			}
685			a.cost += run.CostUSD
686			a.inputTokens += intValue(run.InputTokens)
687			a.outputTokens += intValue(run.OutputTokens)
688			a.cachedTokens += intValue(run.CachedInputTokens)
689			a.retriedTokens += intValue(run.RetriedInputTokens)
690		}
691		cells := make([]matrixCell, 0, len(byKey))
692		for _, a := range byKey {
693			a.cell.CostUSD = a.cost
694			a.cell.InputTokens = a.inputTokens
695			a.cell.OutputTokens = a.outputTokens
696			a.cell.CachedTokens = a.cachedTokens
697			a.cell.RetriedTokens = a.retriedTokens
698			if len(a.rewards) > 0 {
699				mean := mean(a.rewards)
700				sd := sampleSD(a.rewards, mean)
701				a.cell.MeanReward = &mean
702				a.cell.SDReward = &sd
703			}
704			cells = append(cells, a.cell)
705		}
706		sort.Slice(cells, func(i, j int) bool {
707			if cells[i].Harness == cells[j].Harness {
708				return cells[i].ProfileID < cells[j].ProfileID
709			}
710			return cells[i].Harness < cells[j].Harness
711		})
712		return cells
713	}

715	func mean(values []float64) float64 {
716		var sum float64
717		for _, v := range values {

719		}

723	func sampleSD(values []float64, mean float64) float64 {
724		if len(values) < 2 {
725			return 0
726		}
727		var sum float64
728		for _, v := range values {
729			d := v - mean
730			sum += d * d
731		}
732		return math.Sqrt(sum / float64(len(values)-1))
733	}

70	// What it does:
71	//
72	//  1. Loads the frozen subset manifest (default
73	//     scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset.json).
74	//  2. For each entry, locates the upstream task directory under
75	//     scripts/benchmark/external/terminal-bench(-2)/tasks/<id>/.

77	//  4. Captures harness events into ATIF v1.4 trajectory and writes
78	//     them to benchmark-results/termbench/<run-id>/<task>/logs/agent/.

80	//     placed in the same directory and folds the verdict into the
81	//     report. We do NOT run the grader ourselves — running pytest in
82	//     the task's Docker image is upstream's responsibility (see SD-008).

85	// status=ran and no reward — that is the honest outcome the bead

91			// root (each task is a top-level directory), not under tasks/.
92			// SD-008 §1 records this. The legacy TB1 path is also probed.
93			candidates := []string{
94				filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "benchmark", "external", "terminal-bench-2"),
95				filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "benchmark", "external", "terminal-bench", "tasks"),
96			}
97			for _, c := range candidates {
98				if _, err := os.Stat(c); err == nil {
99					tasksDir = c
100					break
101				}
102			}
103		}
104		subsetPath := opts.subsetPath
105		if subsetPath == "" {
106			subsetPath = filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "beadbench", "external", "termbench-subset.json")
107		}

109		subset, err := loadTermbenchSubset(subsetPath)
110		if err != nil {

112			return 1
113		}
114	
115		// Build the agent service once; reuse across tasks.
116		cfg, err := agentConfig.Load(opts.workDir)
117		if err != nil {
118			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: load config: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
119			return 1
120		}
121		svc, err := fizeau.New(fizeau.ServiceOptions{
122			ServiceConfig: &configAdapter{cfg: cfg, workDir: opts.workDir},
123		})
124		if err != nil {
125			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: new service: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
126			return 1
127		}
128	
129		runID := fmt.Sprintf("termbench-%d", time.Now().Unix())
130		outBase := filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "benchmark-results", "termbench", runID)
131		if err := os.MkdirAll(outBase, 0o750); err != nil {
132			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: mkdir: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
133			return 1
134		}
135	
136		report := termbenchRunReport{
137			RunID:     runID,
138			StartedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
139			Subset:    subsetPath,
140			TasksDir:  tasksDir,
141			Harness:   opts.harness,
142			Model:     opts.model,
143		}
144	
145		maxTasks := opts.maxTasks
146		if maxTasks <= 0 || maxTasks > len(subset.Tasks) {
147			maxTasks = len(subset.Tasks)
148		}
149	
150		for i, entry := range subset.Tasks[:maxTasks] {
151			summary := termbenchTaskRunSummary{
152				TaskID:     entry.ID,
153				Category:   entry.Category,
154				Difficulty: entry.Difficulty,
155				Harness:    opts.harness,
156				Model:      opts.model,
157			}
158			taskOutDir := filepath.Join(outBase, entry.ID)
159			taskDir := filepath.Join(tasksDir, entry.ID)
160			if _, err := os.Stat(taskDir); err != nil {
161				summary.Status = "skipped"
162				summary.Error = fmt.Sprintf("task dir not found: %s (submodule not initialized?)", taskDir)
163				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
164				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: %s\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, summary.Error)
165				continue
166			}
167			task, err := termbench.LoadTask(taskDir)
168			if err != nil {
169				summary.Status = "error"
170				summary.Error = err.Error()
171				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
172				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: load task: %v\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, err)
173				continue
174			}
175			if err := os.MkdirAll(taskOutDir, 0o750); err != nil {
176				summary.Status = "error"
177				summary.Error = err.Error()
178				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
179				continue
180			}
181			// For the Go-side dry-run we operate the agent against a fresh
182			// per-task tempdir. Real Harbor runs would mount the container
183			// workspace; here we just need a writable cwd for the fizeau.
184			workDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "termbench-"+entry.ID+"-")
185			if err != nil {
186				summary.Status = "error"
187				summary.Error = err.Error()
188				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
189				continue
190			}
191			defer os.RemoveAll(workDir)
192	
193			plan := termbench.BuildPlan(task, termbench.PlanOptions{
194				Harness:     opts.harness,
195				Model:       opts.model,
196				WorkDir:     workDir,
197				Permissions: opts.permissions,
198			})
199			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), plan.Timeout)
200			start := time.Now()
201			ch, err := svc.Execute(ctx, plan.Request)
202			if err != nil {
203				cancel()
204				summary.Status = "error"
205				summary.Error = err.Error()
206				summary.DurationMS = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
207				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
208				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: execute: %v\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, err)
209				continue
210			}
211			traj := termbench.Capture(ch, termbench.CaptureOptions{
212				SessionID: runID + "/" + entry.ID,
213				TaskID:    entry.ID,
214				Agent: termbench.AgentInfo{
215					Name:      opts.harness,
216					Version:   "bench",
217					ModelName: opts.model,
218				},
219				StartedAt: start,
220			})
221			cancel()
222			if err := termbench.WriteHarnessOutput(taskOutDir, traj); err != nil {
223				summary.Status = "error"
224				summary.Error = err.Error()
225			} else {

227				summary.Trajectory = filepath.Join(taskOutDir, "logs", "agent", "trajectory.json")
228			}
229			summary.ExitCode = traj.ExitCode
230			summary.DurationMS = traj.DurationMS
231			summary.InputTokens = traj.FinalMetrics.InputTokens
232			summary.OutputTokens = traj.FinalMetrics.OutputTokens
233			summary.CostUSD = traj.FinalMetrics.Cost

236			// previous Harbor pass dropped it into the same dir), surface
237			// it. Absent reward stays nil so reporters can distinguish
238			// "not graded" from "graded as failed".
239			if g, gerr := termbench.ReadGraderResult(entry.ID, taskOutDir); gerr == nil {
240				r := g.Reward
241				summary.Reward = &r
242				summary.Status = "graded"
243			} else if !errors.Is(gerr, termbench.ErrNoVerifierOutput) {
244				summary.Error = strings.Join([]string{summary.Error, gerr.Error()}, "; ")
245			}
246	
247			report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
248			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: status=%s exit=%d duration=%dms\n",
249				i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, summary.Status, summary.ExitCode, summary.DurationMS)
250		}
251	
252		if len(report.Notes) == 0 {
253			report.Notes = []string{
254				"Reward fields are populated only when an upstream Harbor verifier has written /logs/verifier/reward.txt into the per-task output directory.",
255				"To complete grading, run: scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh after this command (Docker required).",
256			}
257		}

259		reportPath := filepath.Join(outBase, "results.json")

261		if err != nil {
262			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: marshal report: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
263			return 1

267			return 1

270		return 0
271	}

12	# Solution Design: SD-010 — Multi-Harness × Model Matrix Benchmark
13	
14	**Bead**: agent-fab7feae (Author SD-010 — Multi-Harness × Model Matrix Benchmark)
15	**Type**: Design spec (normative)
16	**Status**: Draft — pending codex peer review and user sign-off on the open question (anchor model)
17	
18	---
19	
20	## 1. Summary
21	
22	This spec governs the **multi-harness × model matrix benchmark**: TerminalBench-2
23	runs that compare ddx-agent against other CLI agent harnesses (initial tranche:
24	`pi`, `opencode`) on a shared anchor model and a shared task subset, and that
25	extend in later tranches to a second model and to frontier-reference cells
26	(`codex`, `claude-code`).
27	
28	**Relation to existing specs.** SD-010 *extends*, it does not replace:
29	
30	- **SD-008** (Terminal-Bench / Harbor integration audit) governs the in-container
31	  `BaseInstalledAgent` integration path. SD-010 is amended into SD-008 §6
32	  ("Multi-Harness Extension") and reuses the in-container layout for every
33	  harness in the matrix. Harnesses that cannot be installed in-container are
34	  documented and dropped — never run host-side.
35	- **SD-009** (ddx-agent Benchmark Mode) governs single-harness ddx-agent
36	  evaluation. Its §5 thresholds (resolved-task floor 0.55, target 0.7) are
37	  **scoped to ddx-agent's own runs only**. Cross-harness cells use **mean reward
38	  ± SD over reps (minimum 3 reps per cell)** and are not gated by those
39	  thresholds. SD-009 §7.1 cross-references SD-010 for the multi-harness
40	  publication policy and §9 lifts the resumability / failure taxonomy normatively.
41	- **FEAT-005** (Logging and Cost) is amended to acknowledge the four token
42	  streams (input, output, cached-input, retried-input) tracked under SD-010,
43	  and to source $-per-Mtok numbers from the SD-010 profile schema rather than
44	  an ad-hoc per-runner constant.
45	
46	The ground truth for the architecture and decisions in this spec is the planning
47	artifact `docs/research/harness-matrix-plan-2026-04-29.md` (v7, codex peer
48	reviewed v2 + v6). That plan closes once the epic bead is filed; subsequent
49	revisions live here in SD-010.
50	
51	**Central caveat (must restate in every published memo).** "Same model,
52	different harness" is *not* a clean control of model capability. Each harness
53	ships its own system prompt, tool schema, retry policy, reasoning effort,
54	context compaction, and default sampling. Matrix results compare *(harness
55	scaffolding + policy) over a shared model API*, not pure harness skill, and
56	not pure model skill.
57	
58	---
59	
60	## 2. Architectural Decisions D1–D6 (Normative)
61	
62	The following decisions are lifted verbatim from `harness-matrix-plan-2026-04-29.md`
63	and are normative for every implementation bead under this spec.
64	
65	### D1. In-container only
66	
67	All harness cells run inside the upstream Harbor container. Mixing host-side
68	and in-container layouts contaminates the comparison. Harnesses that can't be
69	installed in-container are dropped from the matrix (documented in the OSS
70	harness install spike), not run host-side.
71	
72	### D2. Single CLI entry: `ddx-agent-bench matrix`
73	
74	A Go subcommand replaces the parallel-shell-scripts approach. It reuses the
75	existing TB subset loader and harness registry; it shells out to `harbor run`
76	once per run.
77	
78	```
79	ddx-agent-bench matrix \
80	  --subset=scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset-canary.json \
81	  --profiles=gpt-5-3-mini \
82	  --harnesses=ddx-agent,pi,opencode \
83	  --reps=3 \
84	  --budget-usd=15 \
85	  --out=benchmark-results/matrix-<ts>/ \
86	  [--resume] [--force-rerun] [--retry-budget-halted]
87	```
88	
89	No `--concurrency` flag in v1 — see D6.
90	
91	### D3. Smoke vs matrix split
92	
93	The existing `cmd/bench --external=termbench` path **survives** as
94	`--mode=smoke` — fast, ungraded, host tempdir, useful while iterating on
95	ddx-agent code. The matrix subcommand is the **only** graded multi-harness
96	path. The smoke path MUST NOT be used to produce cross-harness comparison
97	memos.
98	
99	### D4. Run state machine and telemetry schema
100	
101	A run has three orthogonal axes; `final_status` is derived from them
102	deterministically. Adapters report the first two; the runner derives the
103	third.
104	
105	```
106	process_outcome  ∈ {completed, timeout, harness_crash, install_failed, harness_refused, budget_halted}
107	grading_outcome  ∈ {graded, ungraded}                # ungraded = no verifier output
108	reward           ∈ {0, 1, null}                      # null iff ungraded
109	
110	final_status (derived)
111	  = graded_pass            if grading_outcome=graded ∧ reward=1
112	  = graded_fail            if grading_outcome=graded ∧ reward=0
113	  = budget_halted          if process_outcome=budget_halted
114	  = install_fail_permanent if process_outcome=install_failed ∧ retriable=false
115	  = install_fail_transient if process_outcome=install_failed ∧ retriable=true
116	  = ran_ungraded           if grading_outcome=ungraded ∧ process_outcome=completed
117	  = <process_outcome>      otherwise                 # timeout, harness_crash, harness_refused
118	```
119	
120	Telemetry schema each adapter MUST emit as part of its `report.json`:
121	
122	```json
123	{
124	  "process_outcome": "completed|timeout|harness_crash|install_failed|harness_refused|budget_halted",
125	  "grading_outcome": "graded|ungraded",
126	  "reward": 0,
127	  "turns": 0, "tool_calls": 0, "tool_call_errors": 0,
128	  "input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0,
129	  "cached_input_tokens": 0, "retried_input_tokens": 0,
130	  "wall_seconds": 0.0
131	}
132	```
133	
134	`null` = unreported; the aggregator drops it from means (denominator shrinks),
135	reports `n/a` in `matrix.md`, and emits `n_reported` alongside. Adapters and
136	aggregator agree by construction — there is one source of truth (the two
137	outcome fields) and one derivation function.
138	
139	### D5. Resumability
140	
141	On `--resume`, a run is **skipped** when
142	`final_status ∈ {graded_pass, graded_fail, install_fail_permanent, budget_halted}`.
143	All other statuses retry on resume.
144	
145	- `--force-rerun` overrides everything (rerun regardless of prior status).
146	- `--retry-budget-halted` retries only `budget_halted` cells (useful after
147	  raising a per-cell cost cap).
148	
149	`budget_halted` is treated as a terminal status because retrying without
150	raising the cap is guaranteed to halt again; the operator must explicitly opt
151	in via `--retry-budget-halted` (or `--force-rerun`).
152	
153	### D6. Concurrency = 1, hard
154	
155	v1 of the matrix runner serializes runs. **No `--concurrency` flag.** Reasons:
156	
157	(a) Docker resource pressure with multiple TB-2 containers running concurrently;
158	(b) provider rate limits hit faster than expected at concurrency > 1;
159	(c) the rate-limit-aware scheduler is its own design problem and shouldn't
160	    gate v1.
161	
162	Concurrent execution is a follow-up bead under a separate epic.

214	## 4. Adapter Contract (Normative)
215	
216	Adapters live under `scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/`. There is **one
217	adapter file per harness**; env-var-based dispatch is forbidden. The cell
218	invocation passes the adapter module path explicitly to Harbor:
219	
220	```
221	harbor run \
222	  --agent scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/ddx_agent.py:Agent \
223	  --task <task-dir> \
224	  --output <cell-out>/<task-id>/ \
225	  --env DDX_BENCH_PROFILE_PATH=<profile.yaml>
226	```
227	
228	### 4.1 Required Python protocol
229	
230	Each adapter declares:
231	
232	```python
233	class Agent(BaseInstalledAgent):
234	    def install(self) -> None: ...
235	    def command(self, task_instruction: str) -> List[str]: ...
236	    def apply_profile(self, profile: dict) -> dict: ...     # YAML → harness-native config
237	    def parse_telemetry(self, trial_dir: Path) -> dict: ... # → D4 schema
238	    def redact_secrets(self, payload: dict) -> dict: ...
239	```
240	
241	Constraints on `command()`:
242	
243	- Non-interactive (no TTY).
244	- `stdin` is `/dev/null`.
245	- Exit code 0 = attempted; non-zero = trial failure (per SD-008).
246	
247	Constraints on `apply_profile()`:
248	
249	- May translate the profile YAML into harness-native config (env, CLI flags,
250	  config file).
251	- MUST NOT silently override the profile's `provider.model`, `sampling`, or
252	  `limits.max_output_tokens`. Any unavoidable translation lossiness is
253	  recorded in the adapter's returned config and surfaced in the cell's
254	  `report.json` `adapter_translation_notes` field.
255	
256	Constraints on `parse_telemetry()`:
257	
258	- Output MUST conform to D4's schema. Fields the harness does not surface are
259	  emitted as `null`, not zero. The aggregator distinguishes "unreported" from
260	  "zero".

283	## 5. Failure Taxonomy and State Machine (Normative)
284	
285	### 5.1 Eleven persisted statuses
286	
287	The complete enumeration of values that may appear as the persisted status in
288	a cell's `report.json`:
289	
290	```
291	install_fail_permanent | install_fail_transient | auth_fail | provider_refusal |
292	timeout | malformed_command | verifier_fail | harness_crash | budget_halted |
293	ran | graded_pass | graded_fail
294	```
295	
296	`graded_pass` and `graded_fail` are the two graded terminal statuses; `ran`
297	denotes a completed-but-ungraded run; the remaining nine cover process and
298	harness failure modes.
299	
300	### 5.2 (process_outcome, grading_outcome, reward) → final_status
301	
302	The state machine is a pure function from the three D4 axes to `final_status`:
303	
304	| process_outcome | grading_outcome | reward | final_status            |
305	|-----------------|-----------------|--------|-------------------------|
306	| completed       | graded          | 1      | graded_pass             |
307	| completed       | graded          | 0      | graded_fail             |
308	| completed       | ungraded        | null   | ran (= ran_ungraded)    |
309	| timeout         | *               | *      | timeout                 |
310	| harness_crash   | *               | *      | harness_crash           |
311	| install_failed  | *               | *      | install_fail_permanent  |
312	|                 |                 |        | / install_fail_transient (per `retriable` flag) |
313	| harness_refused | *               | *      | harness_refused         |
314	| budget_halted   | *               | *      | budget_halted           |
315	
316	Two statuses in §5.1 — `auth_fail`, `provider_refusal`, `malformed_command`,
317	`verifier_fail` — are **specializations** that an adapter MAY emit instead of
318	the broader `harness_crash` / `harness_refused` / `ran_ungraded` when it can
319	discriminate the cause. They are persisted as-is in `report.json`. The
320	aggregator treats every non-`graded_*` status uniformly: dropped from mean
321	reward, itemized in `n_reported`, surfaced in `matrix.md`.
322	
323	### 5.3 Retriability
324	
325	`retriable` is set by the adapter on `install_failed`. Examples:
326	network-flaky package install → retriable; license/ToS rejection → permanent.
327	The default is `retriable=false` if the adapter does not set it.
328	
329	### 5.4 Resumability policy (cross-reference D5)
330	
331	See §2 D5. Restated normatively:
332	
333	- Skip on resume: `graded_pass`, `graded_fail`, `install_fail_permanent`,
334	  `budget_halted`.
335	- Retry on resume: every other status.
336	- Override flags: `--force-rerun` (everything), `--retry-budget-halted`
337	  (`budget_halted` only).

341	## 6. Aggregator Output Format (Normative)
342	
343	`ddx-agent-bench matrix-aggregate <out>/` produces three files in the matrix
344	output directory.
345	
346	### 6.1 `matrix.json`
347	
348	A complete, lossless dump: every cell, every rep, every task, every D4 field.
349	Schema is the union of:
350	
351	- Run-level objects keyed by `(harness, profile_id, rep, task_id)`, each
352	  carrying the full D4 telemetry plus `final_status` and `adapter_translation_notes`.
353	- Cell-level objects keyed by `(harness, profile_id)`, carrying derived
354	  `mean_reward`, `sd_reward`, `n_runs`, `n_reported`, and `cost_usd`.
355	- Matrix-level metadata: pinned harness commits, harness CLI versions, profile
356	  YAML hashes, resolved model snapshot IDs, dataset commit, Harbor commit,
357	  Docker image digests, runner commit, timestamp.
358	
359	`matrix.json` is the source-of-truth artifact. Memos cite it directly.
360	
361	### 6.2 `matrix.md`
362	
363	Human-readable summary in this exact shape:
364	
365	```markdown

369	|-------------|-----------------|--------------------|

114	func cmdMatrix(args []string) int {
115		fs := flagSet("matrix")
116		workDir := fs.String("work-dir", "", "Repository root (default: cwd)")
117		subset := fs.String("subset", "", "TerminalBench subset manifest (default: scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset-canary.json)")
118		profilesCSV := fs.String("profiles", "", "Comma-separated benchmark profile ids")
119		harnessesCSV := fs.String("harnesses", "ddx-agent,pi,opencode", "Comma-separated harness adapter names")
120		reps := fs.Int("reps", 3, "Repetitions per harness/profile/task")
121		budgetUSD := fs.Float64("budget-usd", 0, "Matrix budget in USD (0 = no cap)")
122		out := fs.String("out", "", "Output directory (default: benchmark-results/matrix-<timestamp> under work-dir)")
123		resume := fs.Bool("resume", false, "Skip terminal reports already present under --out")
124		forceRerun := fs.Bool("force-rerun", false, "Rerun every tuple even when a terminal report exists")
125		retryBudgetHalted := fs.Bool("retry-budget-halted", false, "Rerun budget_halted reports while resuming")
126		perRunBudgetUSD := fs.Float64("per-run-budget-usd", 0, "Per-run budget cap in USD (0 = no per-run cap)")
127		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
128			return 2
129		}
130		if *reps <= 0 {
131			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --reps must be > 0\n", benchCommandName())
132			return 2
133		}
134		if *profilesCSV == "" {
135			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles is required\n", benchCommandName())
136			return 2
137		}
138		if *harnessesCSV == "" {
139			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --harnesses is required\n", benchCommandName())
140			return 2
141		}
142	
143		wd := resolveWorkDir(*workDir)
144		subsetPath := *subset
145		if subsetPath == "" {
146			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, defaultMatrixSubset)
147		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(subsetPath) {
148			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, subsetPath)
149		}
150		outDir := *out
151		if outDir == "" {
152			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, "benchmark-results", "matrix-"+time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z"))
153		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(outDir) {
154			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, outDir)
155		}
156	
157		profileIDs := splitCSV(*profilesCSV)
158		harnesses := splitCSV(*harnessesCSV)
159		if len(profileIDs) == 0 || len(harnesses) == 0 {
160			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles and --harnesses must not be empty\n", benchCommandName())
161			return 2
162		}
163	
164		subsetData, err := loadTermbenchSubset(subsetPath)
165		if err != nil {
166			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: load subset %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), subsetPath, err)
167			return 1
168		}
169		profiles, err := selectMatrixProfiles(wd, profileIDs)
170		if err != nil {
171			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
172			return 1
173		}
174		if err := os.MkdirAll(outDir, 0o750); err != nil {
175			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: create output dir: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
176			return 1
177		}
178	
179		var runs []matrixRunReport
180		accumulatedCost := 0.0
181		for _, harness := range harnesses {
182			for _, prof := range profiles {
183				for rep := 1; rep <= *reps; rep++ {
184					for _, task := range subsetData.Tasks {
185						report, skipped, err := runMatrixTuple(matrixTupleOptions{
186							workDir:           wd,
187							outDir:            outDir,
188							harness:           harness,
189							profile:           prof,
190							rep:               rep,
191							task:              task,
192							budgetUSD:         *budgetUSD,
193							perRunBudgetUSD:   *perRunBudgetUSD,
194							accumulatedCost:   accumulatedCost,
195							resume:            *resume,
196							forceRerun:        *forceRerun,
197							retryBudgetHalted: *retryBudgetHalted,
198						})
199						if err != nil {
200							fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
201							return 1
202						}
203						runs = append(runs, report)
204						if !skipped {
205							accumulatedCost += report.CostUSD
206						}
207					}
208				}
209			}
210		}
211	
212		sort.Slice(runs, func(i, j int) bool {
213			return matrixRunKey(runs[i]) < matrixRunKey(runs[j])
214		})
215		output := matrixOutput{
216			GeneratedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
217			SubsetPath:      subsetPath,
218			Profiles:        profileIDs,
219			Harnesses:       harnesses,
220			Reps:            *reps,
221			BudgetUSD:       *budgetUSD,
222			PerRunBudgetUSD: *perRunBudgetUSD,
223			Runs:            runs,
224			Cells:           summarizeMatrixCells(runs),
225			Notes: []string{
226				"v1 runs serially; no concurrency flag is exposed.",
227				"adapter_module records the Python adapter path passed by the runner for the harness cell.",
228			},
229		}
230		matrixPath := filepath.Join(outDir, "matrix.json")
231		if err := writeJSONAtomic(matrixPath, output); err != nil {
232			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: write matrix.json: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
233			return 1
234		}
235		fmt.Printf("matrix results: %s\n", matrixPath)
236		return 0
237	}

254	func runMatrixTuple(opts matrixTupleOptions) (matrixRunReport, bool, error) {
255		cellDir := matrixTupleDir(opts.outDir, opts.harness, opts.profile.ID, opts.rep, opts.task.ID)
256		reportPath := filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixReportName)
257		if !opts.forceRerun {
258			if existing, ok, err := loadExistingMatrixReport(reportPath); err != nil {
259				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
260			} else if ok && shouldSkipMatrixReport(existing.FinalStatus, opts.resume, opts.retryBudgetHalted) {
261				return existing, true, nil
262			}
263		}
264	
265		release, err := acquireMatrixLock(filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixLockName))
266		if err != nil {
267			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
268		}
269		defer release()
270	
271		started := time.Now().UTC()
272		report := matrixRunReport{
273			Harness:         opts.harness,
274			ProfileID:       opts.profile.ID,
275			ProfilePath:     opts.profile.Path,
276			ProfileSnapshot: opts.profile.Versioning.Snapshot,
277			AdapterModule:   matrixAdapterModule(opts.harness),
278			HarborAgent:     filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("scripts", "benchmark", "harness_adapters", moduleFileName(opts.harness))) + ":Agent",
279			Rep:             opts.rep,
280			TaskID:          opts.task.ID,
281			Category:        opts.task.Category,
282			Difficulty:      opts.task.Difficulty,
283			OutputDir:       cellDir,
284			StartedAt:       started,
285			PricingSource:   profilePricingSource(opts.profile),
286		}
287	
288		if opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost >= opts.budgetUSD {
289			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
290			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
291			report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, false)
292			report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
293			if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
294				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
295			}
296			return report, false, nil
297		}
298	
299		workDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, "work")
300		if err := os.MkdirAll(workDir, 0o750); err != nil {
301			return matrixRunReport{}, false, fmt.Errorf("create tuple workdir: %w", err)
302		}
303		result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
304		if err != nil {
305			report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
306			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
307			report.Error = err.Error()
308		} else {
309			report.Command = result.Command.Argv
310			report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
311			report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
312			report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
313			if result.ExitCode != 0 {
314				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
315				report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
316			}
317			applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
318			if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
319				seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
320				report.WallSeconds = &seconds
321			}
322		}
323		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
324			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
325		}
326		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
327			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
328		}
329		if report.Reward != nil && report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
330			report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
331		}
332		report.CostUSD = matrixCostUSD(opts.profile, report)
333		if (opts.perRunBudgetUSD > 0 && report.CostUSD > opts.perRunBudgetUSD) ||
334			(opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost+report.CostUSD > opts.budgetUSD) {
335			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
336			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
337			report.Reward = nil
338		}
339		report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, report.Retriable)
340		report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
341		if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
342			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
343		}
344		return report, false, nil
345	}

347	func runMatrixAdapter(repoRoot, module string, prof *profile.Profile, prompt, taskID, workDir string) (matrixAdapterResult, error) {
348		profileJSON, err := json.Marshal(adapterProfileMapping(prof))
349		if err != nil {
350			return matrixAdapterResult{}, err
351		}
352		script := `
353	import importlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
354	from scripts.benchmark.harness_adapters.base import BenchmarkProfile
355	
356	module = importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1])
357	profile_raw = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
358	prompt = sys.argv[3]
359	task_id = sys.argv[4]
360	workdir = sys.argv[5]
361	agent = module.Agent()
362	profile = BenchmarkProfile.from_mapping(profile_raw)
363	apply = agent.apply_profile(profile)
364	command = agent.command(profile, prompt, workdir)
365	env = os.environ.copy()
366	env.update(getattr(apply, "env", {}) or {})
367	env.update(getattr(command, "env", {}) or {})
368	started = time.time()
369	stdout = ""
370	stderr = ""
371	exit_code = 0
372	argv = list(getattr(command, "argv", []) or [])
373	if argv:
374	    proc = subprocess.run(
375	        argv,
376	        input=getattr(command, "stdin", None),
377	        text=True,
378	        capture_output=True,
379	        cwd=getattr(command, "cwd", None) or workdir,
380	        env=env,
381	        timeout=1800,
382	    )
383	    stdout = proc.stdout
384	    stderr = proc.stderr
385	    exit_code = proc.returncode
386	duration_ms = int((time.time() - started) * 1000)
387	stream = task_id + "\n" + stdout + "\n" + stderr
388	telemetry = agent.parse_telemetry(stream)
389	def spec_to_dict(spec):
390	    return {
391	        "argv": list(getattr(spec, "argv", []) or []),
392	        "env": dict(getattr(spec, "env", {}) or {}),
393	        "notes": list(getattr(spec, "notes", []) or []),
394	        "cwd": getattr(spec, "cwd", None) or "",
395	    }
396	print(json.dumps({
397	    "telemetry": telemetry,
398	    "apply": spec_to_dict(apply),
399	    "command": spec_to_dict(command),
400	    "stdout": stdout,
401	    "stderr": stderr,
402	    "exit_code": exit_code,
403	    "duration_ms": duration_ms,
404	}, sort_keys=True))
405	`
406		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 31*time.Minute)
407		defer cancel()
408		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "python3", "-c", script, module, string(profileJSON), prompt, taskID, workDir)
409		cmd.Dir = repoRoot
410		var stderr bytes.Buffer
411		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
412		out, err := cmd.Output()
413		if ctx.Err() != nil {
414			return matrixAdapterResult{}, ctx.Err()
415		}
416		if err != nil {
417			if stderr.Len() > 0 {
418				return matrixAdapterResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
419			}
420			return matrixAdapterResult{}, err
421		}
422		var result matrixAdapterResult
423		if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &result); err != nil {
424			return matrixAdapterResult{}, fmt.Errorf("parse adapter result: %w", err)
425		}
426		return result, nil
427	}

516	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
517		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
518			return nil, err
519		}
520		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
521		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
522		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
523			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
524			if err == nil {
525				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
526					_ = f.Close()
527					_ = os.Remove(path)
528					return nil, werr
529				}
530				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
531					_ = os.Remove(path)
532					return nil, err
533				}
534				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
535			}
536			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
537				return nil, err
538			}
539			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
540			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
541				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
542					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
543				}
544				continue
545			}
546			pid := "unknown"
547			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
548				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
549			}
550			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
551		}
552		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)
553	}

559		}

561		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &lock); err != nil {

567	func processAlive(pid int) bool {
568		if pid <= 0 {

570		}
571		err := syscall.Kill(pid, 0)
572		return err == nil || errors.Is(err, syscall.EPERM)
573	}

662	func summarizeMatrixCells(runs []matrixRunReport) []matrixCell {
663		type acc struct {
664			cell          matrixCell
665			rewards       []float64
666			cost          float64
667			inputTokens   int
668			outputTokens  int
669			cachedTokens  int
670			retriedTokens int
671		}
672		byKey := map[string]*acc{}
673		for _, run := range runs {
674			key := run.Harness + "\x00" + run.ProfileID
675			a := byKey[key]
676			if a == nil {
677				a = &acc{cell: matrixCell{Harness: run.Harness, ProfileID: run.ProfileID}}
678				byKey[key] = a
679			}
680			a.cell.NRuns++
681			if run.Reward != nil {
682				a.cell.NReported++
683				a.rewards = append(a.rewards, float64(*run.Reward))
684			}
685			a.cost += run.CostUSD
686			a.inputTokens += intValue(run.InputTokens)
687			a.outputTokens += intValue(run.OutputTokens)
688			a.cachedTokens += intValue(run.CachedInputTokens)
689			a.retriedTokens += intValue(run.RetriedInputTokens)
690		}
691		cells := make([]matrixCell, 0, len(byKey))
692		for _, a := range byKey {
693			a.cell.CostUSD = a.cost
694			a.cell.InputTokens = a.inputTokens
695			a.cell.OutputTokens = a.outputTokens
696			a.cell.CachedTokens = a.cachedTokens
697			a.cell.RetriedTokens = a.retriedTokens
698			if len(a.rewards) > 0 {
699				mean := mean(a.rewards)
700				sd := sampleSD(a.rewards, mean)
701				a.cell.MeanReward = &mean
702				a.cell.SDReward = &sd
703			}
704			cells = append(cells, a.cell)
705		}
706		sort.Slice(cells, func(i, j int) bool {
707			if cells[i].Harness == cells[j].Harness {
708				return cells[i].ProfileID < cells[j].ProfileID
709			}
710			return cells[i].Harness < cells[j].Harness
711		})
712		return cells
713	}

715	func mean(values []float64) float64 {
716		var sum float64
717		for _, v := range values {
718			sum += v
719		}
720		return sum / float64(len(values))
721	}

723	func sampleSD(values []float64, mean float64) float64 {
724		if len(values) < 2 {
725			return 0
726		}
727		var sum float64
728		for _, v := range values {
729			d := v - mean
730			sum += d * d
731		}
732		return math.Sqrt(sum / float64(len(values)-1))
733	}

67	// runExternalTermbench is the cmd/bench entry point for `--external=termbench`.
68	// It is invoked from cmdRun when the flag is set; see runner.go.
69	//
70	// What it does:
71	//
72	//  1. Loads the frozen subset manifest (default
73	//     scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset.json).
74	//  2. For each entry, locates the upstream task directory under
75	//     scripts/benchmark/external/terminal-bench(-2)/tasks/<id>/.
76	//  3. Builds an ExecutionPlan and feeds it to fizeau.Service.Execute.
77	//  4. Captures harness events into ATIF v1.4 trajectory and writes
78	//     them to benchmark-results/termbench/<run-id>/<task>/logs/agent/.
79	//  5. Reads any verifier output (reward.txt) the upstream grader has
80	//     placed in the same directory and folds the verdict into the
81	//     report. We do NOT run the grader ourselves — running pytest in
82	//     the task's Docker image is upstream's responsibility (see SD-008).
83	//
84	// On a clean machine with no Docker stack, runs will complete with
85	// status=ran and no reward — that is the honest outcome the bead
86	// describes ("don't fake passing tests").
87	func runExternalTermbench(opts externalRunOptions) int {
88		tasksDir := opts.tasksDir
89		if tasksDir == "" {
90			// terminal-bench-2 layout: task directories live at the repo
91			// root (each task is a top-level directory), not under tasks/.
92			// SD-008 §1 records this. The legacy TB1 path is also probed.
93			candidates := []string{
94				filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "benchmark", "external", "terminal-bench-2"),
95				filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "benchmark", "external", "terminal-bench", "tasks"),
96			}
97			for _, c := range candidates {
98				if _, err := os.Stat(c); err == nil {
99					tasksDir = c
100					break
101				}
102			}
103		}
104		subsetPath := opts.subsetPath
105		if subsetPath == "" {
106			subsetPath = filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "beadbench", "external", "termbench-subset.json")
107		}
108	
109		subset, err := loadTermbenchSubset(subsetPath)
110		if err != nil {
111			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: load subset %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), subsetPath, err)
112			return 1
113		}
114	
115		// Build the agent service once; reuse across tasks.
116		cfg, err := agentConfig.Load(opts.workDir)
117		if err != nil {
118			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: load config: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
119			return 1
120		}
121		svc, err := fizeau.New(fizeau.ServiceOptions{
122			ServiceConfig: &configAdapter{cfg: cfg, workDir: opts.workDir},
123		})
124		if err != nil {
125			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: new service: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
126			return 1
127		}
128	
129		runID := fmt.Sprintf("termbench-%d", time.Now().Unix())
130		outBase := filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "benchmark-results", "termbench", runID)
131		if err := os.MkdirAll(outBase, 0o750); err != nil {
132			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: mkdir: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
133			return 1
134		}
135	
136		report := termbenchRunReport{
137			RunID:     runID,
138			StartedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
139			Subset:    subsetPath,
140			TasksDir:  tasksDir,
141			Harness:   opts.harness,
142			Model:     opts.model,
143		}
144	
145		maxTasks := opts.maxTasks
146		if maxTasks <= 0 || maxTasks > len(subset.Tasks) {
147			maxTasks = len(subset.Tasks)
148		}
149	
150		for i, entry := range subset.Tasks[:maxTasks] {
151			summary := termbenchTaskRunSummary{
152				TaskID:     entry.ID,
153				Category:   entry.Category,
154				Difficulty: entry.Difficulty,
155				Harness:    opts.harness,
156				Model:      opts.model,
157			}
158			taskOutDir := filepath.Join(outBase, entry.ID)
159			taskDir := filepath.Join(tasksDir, entry.ID)
160			if _, err := os.Stat(taskDir); err != nil {
161				summary.Status = "skipped"
162				summary.Error = fmt.Sprintf("task dir not found: %s (submodule not initialized?)", taskDir)
163				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
164				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: %s\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, summary.Error)
165				continue
166			}
167			task, err := termbench.LoadTask(taskDir)
168			if err != nil {
169				summary.Status = "error"
170				summary.Error = err.Error()
171				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
172				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: load task: %v\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, err)
173				continue
174			}
175			if err := os.MkdirAll(taskOutDir, 0o750); err != nil {
176				summary.Status = "error"
177				summary.Error = err.Error()
178				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
179				continue
180			}
181			// For the Go-side dry-run we operate the agent against a fresh
182			// per-task tempdir. Real Harbor runs would mount the container
183			// workspace; here we just need a writable cwd for the fizeau.
184			workDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "termbench-"+entry.ID+"-")
185			if err != nil {
186				summary.Status = "error"
187				summary.Error = err.Error()
188				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
189				continue
190			}
191			defer os.RemoveAll(workDir)
192	
193			plan := termbench.BuildPlan(task, termbench.PlanOptions{
194				Harness:     opts.harness,
195				Model:       opts.model,
196				WorkDir:     workDir,
197				Permissions: opts.permissions,
198			})
199			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), plan.Timeout)
200			start := time.Now()
201			ch, err := svc.Execute(ctx, plan.Request)
202			if err != nil {
203				cancel()
204				summary.Status = "error"
205				summary.Error = err.Error()
206				summary.DurationMS = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
207				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
208				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: execute: %v\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, err)
209				continue
210			}
211			traj := termbench.Capture(ch, termbench.CaptureOptions{
212				SessionID: runID + "/" + entry.ID,
213				TaskID:    entry.ID,
214				Agent: termbench.AgentInfo{
215					Name:      opts.harness,
216					Version:   "bench",
217					ModelName: opts.model,
218				},
219				StartedAt: start,
220			})
221			cancel()
222			if err := termbench.WriteHarnessOutput(taskOutDir, traj); err != nil {
223				summary.Status = "error"
224				summary.Error = err.Error()
225			} else {
226				summary.Status = "ran"
227				summary.Trajectory = filepath.Join(taskOutDir, "logs", "agent", "trajectory.json")
228			}
229			summary.ExitCode = traj.ExitCode
230			summary.DurationMS = traj.DurationMS
231			summary.InputTokens = traj.FinalMetrics.InputTokens
232			summary.OutputTokens = traj.FinalMetrics.OutputTokens
233			summary.CostUSD = traj.FinalMetrics.Cost
234	
235			// If the upstream verifier already produced a reward (e.g. a
236			// previous Harbor pass dropped it into the same dir), surface
237			// it. Absent reward stays nil so reporters can distinguish
238			// "not graded" from "graded as failed".
239			if g, gerr := termbench.ReadGraderResult(entry.ID, taskOutDir); gerr == nil {
240				r := g.Reward
241				summary.Reward = &r
242				summary.Status = "graded"
243			} else if !errors.Is(gerr, termbench.ErrNoVerifierOutput) {
244				summary.Error = strings.Join([]string{summary.Error, gerr.Error()}, "; ")
245			}
246	
247			report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
248			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: status=%s exit=%d duration=%dms\n",
249				i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, summary.Status, summary.ExitCode, summary.DurationMS)
250		}
251	
252		if len(report.Notes) == 0 {
253			report.Notes = []string{
254				"Reward fields are populated only when an upstream Harbor verifier has written /logs/verifier/reward.txt into the per-task output directory.",
255				"To complete grading, run: scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh after this command (Docker required).",
256			}
257		}
258	
259		reportPath := filepath.Join(outBase, "results.json")
260		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
261		if err != nil {
262			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: marshal report: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
263			return 1
264		}
265		if err := os.WriteFile(reportPath, data, 0o600); err != nil {
266			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: write report: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
267			return 1
268		}
269		fmt.Printf("termbench results: %s\n", reportPath)
270		return 0
271	}
